bug_semantics: POST /api/asset/getFileAnnotation is registered with CheckAuth only, so publish RoleReader tokens and anonymous publish readers (when Publish.Auth.Enable is false) can call it. The handler resolves a .sya PDF-annotation path via GetAssetAbsPathInBox and returns the file bytes with no publish-access, publish-ignore, or password check. The sibling GET /assets/* route in serveAssets applies CheckAbsPathAccessableByPublishAccess for non-administrators, including password enforcement. An anonymous reader who knows an asset path can therefore read private highlights/notes of publish-forbidden, password-protected, or unpublished documents. Encrypted-notebook .sya files are fail-closed and out of scope.
flaw_origin: getFileAnnotation existed since the 2022 kernel dump as CheckAuth-only. Document-level publish access (2026-03-12) guarded getFile/getDocAssets but not this handler. The incomplete boundary became the advisory mechanism on 2026-03-17 when PR #17242 added the same CheckAbsPathAccessableByPublishAccess filter to GET /assets/* and omitted getFileAnnotation, creating the guarded-sibling gap the vendor named.
